integrity: The proof is unbounded and consists of exact equivalences from \(\varphi(pq)\mid(pq)^2-1\) to a coprime normalized divisibility, then to a finite divisor-pair factorization for each gcd parameter. The attached finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only composite integers with \(\Omega(n)=2\). It does not classify higher multiplicative-complexity layers and makes no infinitude claim for the generated prime pairs.
title: An exact divisor parametrization of the semiprime layer of \(\varphi(n)\mid n^2-1\)
